messages:
maddy: kicking off intake for meridian-11b bring-up. goal: onboard baseline fp16, then int8, then int4 smoke. primary focus is perf (throughput/latency) + basic quality guardrails before wider rollout. :seedling:

samir: SGTM. do we have a target perf SLO to gate on? especially for ctx=1024 batch=1 95p latency

maddy: propose SLOs: 95p < 350ms at ctx=1024 batch=1 on dedicated A100-equivalent. throughput goals: >= 120 rps for batch=8 at ctx=512. can tweak if infra says unrealistic.

olivia: adding quality checks: run prod-lite-evals v3 (core-prod-prompts + safety-smoke). require no >5% delta in answer-rate and no safety regressions.

lee: roadmap for perf experiments:
- smoke: fp16 single-node run (ctx: 512,1024,2048) batch sizes [1,4,8]
- sweep: extended ctx [512,1024,2048,4096,8192] at batch 1 and burst-8
- quant: int8 profile then int4 smoke; measure p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/s, memory headroom
- warmup: KV prefix priming for chat-like traces (seqs=128 typical)

maddy: infra ask: need 2x 24h slots on dedicated-gpu-small pool (tag: dedicated-gpu-rtx-a6000-pool) for smoke tomorrow afternoon. can we get them?

infra-bot: @maddy requested 2 slots on dedicated-gpu-rtx-a6000-pool for 24h each. queue id: q-1793412345-01. ETA scheduling: 2024-08-02 14:00 UTC.

samir: nice. for quant runs, can we use the new quant-runtime-1.4 that supports asymmetric int4? last time int4 needed a tiny patch for kv-cache alignment.

lee: yes use quant-runtime-1.4. added a quick patch snippet for alignment in case it shows up again:
```
# alignment fix (pseudo)
if kv_cache_stride % 128 != 0:
    pad_kv_cache(128 - (kv_cache_stride % 128))
```

olivia: test plan for quality/regressions:
- baseline fp16 eval on prod-lite-evals v3
- int8 comparison: run same evals with top-k/top-p temp settings preserved
- int4 smoke: run 1000-sample subset from core prompts and inspect BLEU/ROUGE-ish proxies + human spot-check 20 examples
- automated threshold: answer-rate delta <=5% and avg helpfulness delta <=8% (measured by eval harness)

maddy: batching config we plan to try (starting point):
```json
{"max_batch_size": 8, "max_latency_ms": 80, "pad_trunc_strategy": "dynamic", "batch_timeout_ms": 10}
```

samir: small note: for long ctx sweeps we should enable streaming off for fair latency measures (streaming adds overhead). also measure with streaming on as secondary.

lee: agree. also capture memory peaks via nvidia-smi loop and runtime telemetry. add kv-cache-reserve metric.

maddy: blockers: 
- infra slot confirmation (queued)
- quant-runtime flag currently behind feature-flag for private deploys (need devops enable)
- eval harness needs updated tokenizers for meridian vocab (I can ship tokenizer PR today)

olivia: i'll coordinate the eval harness PR review. ping me when tokenizer PR is ready.

samir: i'll run the int8 smoke after slots are live. aiming for 2024-08-02 18:00 UTC. I'll post raw bench CSVs to the bench-bucket and a short heatmap.

maddy: plan to produce deliverables:
- 1-page quick summary (SLO pass/fail, major regressions)
- perf matrix CSV (ctx x batch x quant)
- heatmaps for latency and throughput
- list of follow-ups (e.g., kernel tweak, batch sizing changes, caching improvements)

lee: assign owners:
- bench runs + raw data: samir
- evals + quality summary: olivia
- tokenizer + perf harness glue: maddy
- infra scheduling + slot ops: infra-team / infra-bot

maddy: timeline:
- today: tokenizer PR + bench config commit
- tomorrow (slot day): smoke fp16 + int8, initial evals
- +48h: int4 smoke + extended ctx sweep
- deliverable draft +1 week

olivia: lgtm. if int4 shows >10% quality delta we block rollout and open a regression ticket.

samir: quick ask — can we add a short-run for batching=16 at ctx=512 to see scaling point? probably useful for tail latency.

maddy: yes include batch=16 single-run for ctx=512 and 1024, mark as optional.

infra-bot: q-1793412345-01 allocated 2 slots on dedicated-gpu-rtx-a6000-pool starting 2024-08-02T14:05:00Z. job ids: job-1793412345-a, job-1793412345-b. Please use labels: meridian-11b-onboard.

lee: awesome. i'll add bench dashboards and traces template (x-ray links) once samir uploads CSVs.

maddy: thanks all. will drop final checklist in this thread when tokenizer PR is merged and slots show active. :rocket:
